reviews.note: The account activity text asserts completed pension credit; its actual issuer is not authenticated by these labels.

reviews.eventQuote: The pension arrived and was booked as a credit in your available account balance.
reviews.note: An account-style report states that the pension arrived and was booked.

reviews.eventQuote: وصل المعاش وسجل دائناً في حسابك المتاح.
reviews.note: The quoted event describes completed credit inside a demo. The governing demo frame makes the original transaction target nontransaction; it does not change the embedded event's tense/state.

reviews.contextQuote: Demo display unrelated to your account:
reviews.eventQuote: The pension arrived and was booked as a credit in your available account balance.
reviews.note: The same completed credit clause is quoted in a demo unrelated to the account. Context and described event state must be separate.
Cash was actually credited. The later ليست رصيد نقاط negates the points interpretation, not the posted cash credit.

reviews.eventQuote: The reward has actually been added to your account.
reviews.note: Posted money is asserted. The phrase not loyalty points does not negate the credited money.

reviews.contextQuote: هذه نقاط مكافآت وليست إضافة مالية
reviews.eventQuote: وليست إضافة مالية؛ لم يتغير رصيد المال.
reviews.note: A noncash loyalty-points update. The selected financial event is the expressly denied cash addition, not an attempt inferred from nowhere. A balance-only statement without that denied credit proposition would instead be no_event.

reviews.contextQuote: These are reward points rather than a cash credit
reviews.eventQuote: rather than a cash credit; the money balance has not changed.
reviews.note: The governing purpose is a noncash points update, and a monetary credit is explicitly denied. This selects that denied credit proposition, not the points award as a money event.

reviews.eventQuote: سجل خصم الكتب من «مكتبة انتظار» في كشف حسابك.
reviews.note: انتظار is inside the fictional shop name after من; it is not the posting status. The debit is recorded in the statement.

reviews.eventQuote: The book purchase debit from Pending Books was recorded in your statement.
reviews.note: Pending belongs to the fictional merchant name, not a pending-payment assertion. Recorded debit governs the event state.

reviews.eventQuote: المبلغ محجوز مؤقتاً فقط ولم يسجل خصم نهائي.
reviews.note: Here pending qualifies the actual settlement state. The message explicitly denies a final debit and reports only a temporary hold.

reviews.eventQuote: The amount is temporarily held only; no final debit was recorded.
reviews.note: This is an actual pending authorization, not a merchant name. No settled debit is recorded.
